title: Flagstaff House, Hong Kong

mappedWholeFeature.scopeCut: Main rectangular historic house only; cut at south wall where the narrow connection to the later gallery begins.

geometryLabel: Main rectangular historic house only. Narrow connecting passage and later K.S.Lo Gallery excluded.
identityStatus: Selected local exterior original, official AMO architecture record and aerial main-roof/gallery context inspected.

orientationControl.basis: Long garden entrance facade faces south-southwest; Lippo Centre lies behind the north/east side. Aerial distinguishes the four-chimney hipped main roof from narrow gallery connection.

terrainContact.basis: Park-side forecourt just beyond the central entrance steps; independent ground reference.

source: Protomaps/OpenStreetMap; local Qualla exterior original; Antiquities and Monuments Office architecture record; aerial roof context.
notes: Main mapped envelope about35m by23m. Two-storey house with deep verandahs, classical columns, shutters, white louvres, low panelled upper railing, hipped tiled roof and four visible roof chimneys. Heights and partly hidden rear details are estimates, not measured elevations.
limitations: Main house only; exclude later gallery, connector, trees, displays, temporary exhibition banners and interiors.
Independent Hong Kong ground evidence retained; footprint replacement disabled.
